budget_status: proposal, not an owner-approved performance gate
adaptations: The original reference files stay byte-exact. At build time only Data::skin is replaced with the reviewed MRC1 f32 accessor: the asset already stores decoded, normalized skin transforms.
The adapter constructs the same explicit clip phases/full-body cross-fade from supplied Anim values. It places reference rigid transforms into the target palette using rotated basis vectors.
evaluateAll, frame selection and blending are the pinned native code; its temporary vector allocation is measured, not removed. The Coax admission and reference MRC1 reader are separate.
